gaps.sentence: So convincing ___ his argument that nobody objected.
gaps.explanation: So + adjective at the front: was his argument that…

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not since the 1990s ___ unemployment been so low.
gaps.explanation: Not since X has Y happened — present perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ a debut film attracted such wide attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely has a debut film attracted …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ she won the marathon, but she also broke the course record.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only has she won' — inversion with the present perfect auxiliary.

gaps.sentence: Should the temperature ___ 40 degrees, the system shuts down.
gaps.explanation: Should the temperature exceed… = if it exceeds… — technical register.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last guest had left ___ she sit down.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … had left did she sit down' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: So convincing ___ her argument that even the sceptics agreed.
gaps.explanation: 'So convincing was her argument that …' — 'so + adj' fronted with inversion.
